question: Should localization coverage remain a core-owned closed union of all product, channel, plugin, and skill surfaces, or should core expose a generic contract while each owner registers and validates its own coverage?
rationale: This determines the long-lived ownership and compatibility boundary; the mechanically correct implementation depends on whether optional surfaces must be enumerated by core.

options.title: Use owner registrations
options.body: Keep only generic coverage types and aggregation in core, while channel, plugin, and skill owners provide their own registrations and checks.

options.title: Adopt the fixed core union
options.body: Accept that each listed owner-specific surface is centrally governed and requires coordinated core edits whenever its localization contract changes.

recommendation.title: Use owner registrations
recommendation.body: Keep only generic coverage types and aggregation in core, while channel, plugin, and skill owners provide their own registrations and checks.
